commands.command: cargo clippy -p quansio-qworkerd -p quansio-machine -p quansio-server --all-targets -- -D warnings  # exit captured before filtering
arch_check.py + pytest tests/architecture  # 129 passed, forbidden wiring clean, the validator passes
gen_contracts.py --check --only catalog,openapi,sdk,ts,rust  # SendBrowserInput regenerated from DOMAIN.md; no hand edits
cd apps/desktop && tsc --noEmit && eslint src tests

cd apps/desktop && vitest run live-input preload live-decisions live live.e2e conversation.e2e trust.e2e  # the suites this change touches, with the dev stack up: a click maps to page coordinates from the frame's own size and is not sent when it cannot be placed; the builder refuses what the server refuses; the channel is allowlisted and sends the params the command defines; the live view calls only that channel and only while the person holds the session; the conversation and trust E2E run against the real server with the stub opted in explicitly

cd apps/desktop && vitest run  # the whole desktop suite with the dev stack up: 667 passed, 2 FAILED. tests/automation.e2e (ADP-007 added a 60 s plan minimum; the test still schedules a 1 s routine; fails on main) and tests/work.e2e (CONFLICT_REVISION race under parallel load; passes alone 3 of 3). Neither touches this change

RUST_MIN_STACK=16777216 cargo test --no-fail-fast -p quansio-machine -p quansio-qworkerd -p quansio-server  # 1328 passed, 0 failed: real PostgreSQL, a real worker over a Unix socket and a real Chrome. worker_live (9): a guard report reaches the database and a worker cannot write another target's session; RequestTakeover/Handback move the worker's driver and the page sees only the person's clicks; a decision is relayed and the response says when no worker was reached; frames reach the live hub while a person holds the session and a handback stops the stream (proved by the next takeover starting a new one); a forged frame for another target's session is never published; SendBrowserInput is delivered only while the person holds the session, every malformed input is refused and an undeliverable one is an error; a missed handback is repaired before the next agent call. daemon_orders: a worker takes orders only while it holds a lease and rebuilds a receipt only from a valid wire form

mutation checks L1-L9 all KILLED (L4 survived the first test and was killed after the test was rewritten): guard report from another target, frame without checking its session, takeover never starts the stream, handback never stops it, input accepted while the agent holds the session, orders without a lease, control not restated, unknown decision kind accepted, a second place rebuilding a receipt from the wire; every mutant compiles; the restored control passes
